**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user has a collection of 57 rare records.
- [PREFERENCE] The user prefers to use Google Sheets for organizing their record collection.
- [EVENT] The user is trying to organize their collections and is looking for a good template for inventorying their rare records.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided a list of template options for inventorying records, including Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, Discogs, Music Collector, Record Collector's Guild, and printable record inventory sheets.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested columns for the Google Sheets template: Record Title, Artist, Release Year, Label, Catalog Number, Condition, Value, Purchase Date, Purchase Price, and Location.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended taking high-quality photos of records and keeping the inventory updated.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided resources for finding rare records online, including Discogs, eBay, MusicStack, Reddit's r/vinylcollectors, Vinyl Collective, Facebook Groups, local record stores, online record stores, independent labels, auction sites like eBid and HA.com, garage sales, Craigslist, and record fairs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised the user to research sellers and inspect record conditions before purchasing.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is always on the lookout for new additions to their record collection.
- [EVENT] The user is considering getting their rare figurines appraised.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided resources for figurine appraisal, including the International Society of Appraisers, Appraisers Association of America, Weta Workshop, Lelands, Heritage Auctions, eBay, figurine collectors' forums, local collectible stores, comic book stores, and collectible toy stores.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested that the user research the appraiser's credentials and get multiple appraisals for accuracy.
- [FACT] The user has a limited edition Batman variant figurine that they got at Comic-Con last year.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant discussed the pros and cons of appraising figurines separately versus as a collection, noting that individual appraisal is best for unique values and conditions.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is considering whether to get their rare figurines appraised separately or as a collection.
